source_authority: Cached Another Eden Wiki Superbosses index/detail pages; index rows are discovery metadata only.
identity_policy: canonical_id is the only cohort identity; aliases and variants never create a second cohort count.

fetch_policy.fetch_scope: Exactly these 30 records: 25 proposed_pending_live_fetch candidates plus the five cached_pending_repair weak bosses, one bounded detail-page fetch per canonical identity; no index discovery, all-boss admission, or recursive crawl.
